title: Evolis SMP
description: Evolis SMP is a semi-vanilla SMP with twists that rotate each season, Season 4 has Ranked SMP.
body:
# 🌍 Evolis SMP – Season 4

*Evolis SMP is a semi-vanilla, ranked-inspired server focused on competitive gameplay, balanced mechanics, and a strong community.*

## ⚔ Server Highlights

✅ Ranked SMP mechanics
✅ Griefing & PvP enabled
✅ Hacking strictly prohibited
✅ Teams system with shared homes & team warps
✅ Community polls influence seasonal changes
✅ Reliable anti-cheat & active staff

Plugin list in the [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/UvE6vdwJQX)

Designed for strategic alliances, organized wars, and long-term progression.

🚀 Season 4 is soon to be launched. Join now to be part of the Evolis SMP.

👉 https://discord.gg/UvE6vdwJQX
